name: lpdfio/lpdf
description: PHP SDK for Lpdf, the PDF engine that renders a document written in XML or built in code to the same PDF in every language.

suggest.ext-ffi: Renders in PHP's own process through the native library in the package, with no wasmtime to install: Linux with glibc 2.17 or newer, x86_64 or arm64, and ffi.enable=true for a web server
suggest.ext-posix: Lets the SDK give wasmtime a folder of its own for the engine it compiles, which it needs where PHP's user can't write its home, as www-data under PHP-FPM
